name: 情報元変更の影響・測定値・通知間隔を設定する進捗編集領域
prompt:
Create a faithful Japanese localized image of the complete goal progress settings dialog in the supplied references. Use the original Asana screenshot crop as the primary authority for geometry, hierarchy, and control details. Use the Japanese preview for exact localized labels and the intended Lighthouse green state styling. Output only the settings dialog on a clean white canvas at the original crop's 1920:1199 aspect ratio (about 1.60:1), scaled consistently; include all dialog content from the title bar through the bottom action bar. Do not include the black Mobbin branding strip, a browser frame, extra panels, or invented controls.

Follow this vertical order and spacing from the original: a top title bar with centered 「目標の進捗設定」 and a small close X at the far right; a full-width pale mint warning banner with a small warning icon and exactly 「接続した子目標は進捗の計算に含まれなくなります。」; a centered main content column with the heading 「進捗の情報元」 and four evenly spaced choice cards in one row: 「子目標」 / 「自動で更新」, 「案件」 / 「自動で更新」, 「作業」 / 「自動で更新」, and 「手動」. The manual card is selected, using the Japanese preview's pale green fill, green outline, and green label. Below, show the bold subheading 「手動」 and the helper line 「この目標の進捗は手動で更新します。」.

Below that, reproduce one light bordered measurement panel with the heading 「測定方法」; a compact dropdown on the left labeled 「% 割合」; a quiet text dropdown at the upper right labeled 「小数なし」; and one horizontal row of three labeled fields: 「現在の値」 with 「40%」, 「開始の値 *」 with 「10%」, then a small bidirectional arrow, then 「目標の値 *」 with 「100%」. Preserve the original's clean input borders and field proportions. Below the panel, show the heading 「状態の更新通知」 and a divider. Its single row has 「通知の間隔」 at left, the helper text 「目標の状態を更新する通知を定期的に受け取ります。」 beneath it, and a compact outlined dropdown on the far right with 「毎週」 and a down chevron; include the bottom divider.

Anchor a thin footer action bar to the bottom of the dialog, with a neutral outlined 「取消し」 button and a green 「保存」 button at the right. Keep the body centered and compact with the original's spacing, crisp Japanese sans-serif type, subtle neutral borders, and restrained colors. Use no extra Japanese or English words.
reviewNotes: Registered v001 with stored:true and catalogUpdated:true. Candidate measures 1586x992 (1.599:1), matching the original crop's 1.601:1; all Japanese content and dialog controls are present. SHA-256 matches the saved PNG, manifest, and all-items catalog; metadata includes prompt and input references; refreshed HTML contains the image and stored image was opened.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
